findings_qualitative.value: HCO+ and H13CO+ show centrally peaked profiles with step-like changes in slope near the 2nd and 3rd dust rings; HC15N may follow the dust rings

evidence.quote: The intensity profile appears to peak in a ring which appears to match well with the mm-sized dust distribution at the same spatial resolution.

claims.hypothesis: Does chemistry with a smooth disk structure explain the HCO+ and H13CO+ profiles?
claims.experiment: LIME models on DIANA structure compared with observed radial profiles
claims.result: Fiducial model overestimates emission and gives wrong morphology and ratio trend
claims.finding: Smooth model with canonical isotope ratio fails; gas in cavity and altered abundances needed

evidence.quote: Model 1 is the fiducial model as described above and this model is found to overestimate the magnitude of the emission

claims.hypothesis: Is a constant HCO+/H13CO+ ratio consistent with the data?
claims.experiment: Adjust H13CO+ abundance multiplier by region
claims.result: Ratio needs to drop to ~35 inside 200 au and ~11.5 outside
claims.finding: Enhanced H13CO+ in the outer disk suggests a cold (<~10 K) reservoir; isotope-selective chemistry alone insufficient

evidence.quote: The enhancement in relative to can be explained by a cold reservoir of gas in the outer disk ($\lesssim$ 10 K, $\gtrsim$ 200 au)

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Dust opacity suppression of inner emission rejected (10-20% effect)

evidence.quote: Hence, the emission in the inner disk is not significantly suppressed due to dust opacity.

limitations_admitted.value: Fits are by eye; no main-isotopologue HCN data; low S/N for HC15N

evidence.quote: due to the low S/N of the data a centrally peaked smooth radial intensity profile cannot be ruled out
